title: Kwinjira mu igerageza
intro: Hitamo umukoresha w'igerageza n'aho raporo igarukira kugira ngo urebe Imbonerahamwe y'Ubuyobozi bwa Porogaramu ukoresheje amakuru y'igerageza.
notProvided: Kwinjira nyakuri, MFA no kwinjira rimwe (OIDC) ntibitangwa muri iri gerageza.
chooseScopeHint: Uburenganzira bwawe bukubiyemo uturere turenze kamwe. Hitamo icyo raporo izerekana; ushobora kubihindura nyuma uhinduye umukoresha.

validation.personaRequired: Hitamo umukoresha w'igerageza kugira ngo ukomeze
validation.scopeRequired: Hitamo aho raporo igarukira kugira ngo ukomeze

noGrant: Uyu mukoresha nta burenganzira afite mu makuru y'igerageza. Hitamo undi mukoresha cyangwa usubize igerageza ku ntangiriro.
redirectNotice: Injira kugira ngo ufungure paji wasabye.
